text:
matt: follow-up from last night's incident — want to lock owners for the remediation items and decide whether we touch SLOs. planned items: 1) route-level throttles, 2) cache regen backoff, 3) dashboard panels (p95/p99 by model+seq), 4) recurrence detection. propose 48h quick fixes, 14d for full rollout.
olivia: i'll take cache regen backoff (INF-7101). i'll add jitter + exponential backoff and a traffic-safe canary. aiming for a canary by 2026-03-29.
cheng: i can own routing throttles (INF-7102). prefer progressive throttling per-route rather than changing SLOs. will prototype in staging today. snippet i'll test: ```
routing:
  /v1/generate:
    low_priority_throttle: 0.3
```
sara: i'll own dashboards and recurrence alert (INF-7103). will add seq-length buckets [0-128,129-512,513-2048,2049+] and a p99 heatmap by route. draft panels by tomorrow morning.
notif-bot: INF-7101 created (cache backoff)  owner: olivia  due: 2026-03-29.
notif-bot: INF-7102 created (routing throttles)  owner: cheng  due: 2026-03-28.
notif-bot: INF-7103 created (dashboards)  owner: sara  due: 2026-03-27.
matt: on SLOs 1212 prefer not to change SLO numbers unless mitigations fail. fallback plan: temporary p99 shift with auto-unwind after 10d and customer notice. 24h objection window.
olivia: +1 to avoid SLO change. if mitigations fail we can escalate to RFC.
cheng: testing progressive throttles first. if we still see >3% error-budget burn in 48h after mitigations, we'll re-evaluate.
sara: adding recurrence annotation to postmortem and a derived metric for 3-week spikes. will link to runbook.
matt: assigning INF-7104 -> matt (postmortem owners + RFC draft)  due 2026-03-26. please update tickets with validation steps and rollback plans.
notif-bot: INF-7104 created (postmortem owners + RFC)  owner: matt  due: 2026-03-26.
olivia: validation plan: loadtest with staggered cache regen, metric: p99 delta <10% vs baseline and no CPU saturation.
cheng: throttle test: will submit PR with config and gating loadtest results.
sara: will wire alerts: if 24h error-budget burn >2% or p99 increase >200ms then page.
matt: ok. syncing tomorrow 09:30 to validate canary results. flag if you cannot meet deadlines.
olivia: ACK.
cheng: ACK.
sara: ACK.
